_comment: Economy v1 D4 canonical proof. The whole coin arc in one run: (1) CHORE EARN -- clean dirty_table in the inn (Earned 1 gold + gold_changed), open the I panel to prove the D3 coin line shows 'Gold: 1' in its ui_inventory_shown payload; (2) cross the mandatory floodplains ambush (Relc-allied) to the street -- a LOOT-GOLD FIGHT (goblin_encounter_1 drops gold 2 at seed 9, D2's isolated-RNG verdict) -> gold 3; (3) KRSHIA BUY ATTEMPT WHILE BROKE -- open the stall at 3 gold, every buy option greys (the charm's own 'costs 5 gold' lock proves the affordability-negative surface honestly in the dialogue_node options payload); (4) EARN TO PRICE via a second loot-gold fight, crate_scavengers (gold 2 at seed 9) -> gold 5; (5) SUCCESSFUL BUY -- the charm now ungreyed, buy it (Paid 5 gold + item_gained{traveler_charm} + gold_changed decrement) -> gold 0; (6) I PANEL open, payload gold asserted (0, proving the spend decrement reached the coin line). Geography note: gold is inn-only earn while Krshia + loot fights are street-only, separated by a corridor-free (warrior-gated) ambush, so the loot fights double as the crossing + the earn-to-price; the ambush loot is genuinely won before Krshia is reachable. LOOT gold is isolated by the CLI --seed (=9), fight OUTCOMES by the fixture rng_state (=9) -- both fights won at that state. Seed 9, fixture rng governs the fights.

steps._comment: == (1) CHORE EARN ==. Spawn (2,3), east to (5,3), face down into dirty_table (5,4) and clean it -> the D2 wage (gold 1) rides the on_skill_use effect alongside the clean toast/accomplishment.

D3 coin line: open the I panel -- ui_inventory_shown now carries gold, so the payload proves the coin line renders the live total (Gold: 1) with the two carried items. M-LEGIBILITY L2 also pins item_effect_lines parallel to [rusty_sword, relcs_spare_spear]: rusty_sword's card is line-free ([]), the spear's card shows its generated +1 damage line.
steps.name: inventory

steps._comment: == (2) cross to the street via the mandatory floodplains ambush ==. (5,3) east to (14,3), interact inn_door (15,3) -> floodplains (7,6).
LOOT-GOLD FIGHT #1: goblin_encounter_1 drops gold 2 at seed 9 (isolated hash(run_seed,encounter_id), D2). Whole-run scan avoids the victory-toast ordering.
Gate onto the street. (30,20-ish) right1, down3 -> (31,24), interact liscor_gate -> street (1,3).

== (3) KRSHIA BUY ATTEMPT WHILE BROKE ==. East to Krshia's column (13,3), bump north into her (13,2 blocked). First talk this waking = her rotating pool line; a second interact opens the crate graph (hub).
Fresh hub (no crate/wrong-order accomplishments): visible options are pitch(0), shop-entry(1), Just visiting(2). Down 1 to the shop-entry, confirm.

BROKE (3 gold): EVERY buy greys -- the charm's own 'costs 5 gold' lock is the honest affordability-negative surface. Full options array pinned (test_driver array match is size-exact). M-LEGIBILITY L2: each buy option now carries effect_lines (its item's generated combat line, price-stripped -- the price is already in the option text), so the greyed buys still answer 'what am I buying'; 'Nothing today.' grants no item so it has NO effect_lines key. M-GEAR Task G2 (HAZARD 1): 'Show me the charms.' is a plain ungated nav (no requires -> no gold gate -> no effect_lines key, same shape as 'Nothing today.'), appended after the 4 buys and before 'Nothing today.' -- the 4 buys keep their exact pre-G2 indices 0-3.

options.text: That Silverfang hunting knife. Good steel. (15 gold)
The wool-lined cloak. The wet gets in, out on the road. (18 gold)

steps._comment: Leave the stall while broke: 'Nothing today.' is now index 5 (the new 'Show me the charms.' nav took index 4) -> hub, then 'Just visiting.' (index 2) -> ends. No quest accepted (asked_about_crate stays 0).

== (4) EARN TO PRICE: loot-gold fight #2 (crate_scavengers) ==. From (13,3) south to the crate cluster: down10 -> (13,13), left3 -> (10,13), down3 -> (10,16), right2 stops at (11,16) (crate blocks 12,16), interact -> combat. crate_scavengers is interact-only (no quest gate needed).

== (5) SUCCESSFUL BUY ==. Back to Krshia (13,3): reverse the outbound detour (left1, up3, right3, up10). Pool already spent this waking, so interact opens the graph directly. crate victory banked found_the_crate, so the hub now shows a report option -- 'Your crate's accounted for.' at visible index 1 -- pushing the shop-entry to index 2 (down 2).

AFFORDABLE now (5 gold): the charm ungreys (locked:false), the pricier three still grey. M-LEGIBILITY L2: effect_lines ride each buy option regardless of the greyed state (the ungreyed charm shows '+2 HP' at full color, the rest greyed). M-GEAR Task G2: 'Show me the charms.' nav stays ungated regardless of gold.

options.text: That Silverfang hunting knife. Good steel. (15 gold)
The wool-lined cloak. The wet gets in, out on the road. (18 gold)

steps._comment: Buy the charm (index 0, ungreyed): effects [{gold:-5},{item:traveler_charm}] behind the requires:{gold:5} gate. spend_gold emits gold_changed BEFORE the 'Paid' toast, then the item grant -- wait in emission order.
steps.name: confirm

== (6) I PANEL, payload gold asserted ==. Purse spent to 0, pack now holds 3 items (charm added). The coin line reads 'Gold: 0' and the ui_inventory_shown payload carries the decremented total -- proof the spend reached the panel. M-LEGIBILITY L2: item_effect_lines parallel to [rusty_sword, relcs_spare_spear, traveler_charm] -- the just-bought charm's card shows its generated +2 HP and gold-value lines.
